# gherkingen

> A Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) test boilerplate generator for Go: it
> parses Cucumber/Gherkin `*.feature` files and produces table-driven,
> parallel Go test skeletons via customizable text/template templates.

- Language: Go; module `github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen/v4`; CLI binary `gherkingen`.
- Install: `go install github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen/v4/cmd/gherkingen@latest`,
  Homebrew `brew install hedhyw/gherkingen/gherkingen`, or Docker `hedhyw/gherkingen`.
- Usage: `gherkingen EXAMPLE.feature`; formats: `autodetect`, `go`, `json`, `raw`;
  custom output via `-template my_template.tmpl` (embedded default `@/std.simple.v1.go.tmpl`).
- Supports any Go testing framework and non-Go languages through custom templates
  (`-format raw`); understands non-English Gherkin dialects (`-language`).
- License: MIT.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen/blob/main/README.md): full
  installation, usage, and template-authoring guide.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  repository guide for AI coding agents (layout, build/test/lint, generated files).
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen/v4): Go package
  documentation.
